places.name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
places.ai_summary: A revered Buddhist temple housing a sacred tooth relic of Lord Buddha, a must-visit for spiritual and cultural enthusiasts.
places.name_english: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

opening_hours.notes: Special ceremonies held daily.

places.place_tip: Wear modest clothing and remove shoes before entering.
places.address: Sri Dalada Veediya, Kandy, Sri Lanka

attribution.title: SL Kandy asv2020-01 img33 Sacred Tooth Temple
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Sacred Tooth Temple in Kandy, Sri Lanka

places.name: Royal Botanical Gardens
places.ai_summary: A sprawling garden featuring exotic plants, orchids, and a giant Javan fig tree, perfect for nature lovers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the orchid house and the suspension bridge.

attribution.title: Botanical Garden of Peradeniya 03
attribution.author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution.description: Botanical Garden of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka

places.name: Kandy Lake
places.ai_summary: A picturesque lake in the heart of Kandy, ideal for a serene walk or a boat ride.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride and visit the small island in the lake.

places.name: Bahirawakanda Buddha Statue
places.ai_summary: A massive Buddha statue on a hilltop, offering panoramic views of Kandy and its surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Climbing the hill takes about 20 minutes.

places.place_tip: The view from the top is breathtaking, especially at sunset.

attribution.title: Sri Maha Bodhi Vihara Statue
attribution.author: Price Zero
attribution.description: Buddha statue of Sri Maha Bodhi Viharaya

places.name: Udawattekele Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A tranquil forest reserve in the city, perfect for a nature walk and bird watching.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available.

places.place_tip: Look out for the various bird species and the beautiful trees.

attribution.title: Sri Lanka - 029 - Kandy Temple of the Tooth
attribution.author: McKay Savage from Chennai, India
attribution.description: The Temple of the Tooth in Kandy. This temple is one of the most holy sites in Sri Lanka reputed to contain an actual tooth of the Buddha on his 2nd visit to the Island over 2000 years ago.

places.name: Kandy Viewpoint (Arthur’s Seat)
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint offering stunning views of Kandy and the surrounding hills, especially beautiful at sunrise and sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: The viewpoint can be reached by a short hike.

attribution.title: Ella, Sri Lanka, Mountains in clouds, Panorama
attribution.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
attribution.description: Ella, Sri Lanka. Ella Valley (Gap) in Sri Lanka is at about 1000m elevation. The hills are covered with cloud forest and rain forest.

places.name: Kandy City Center (Shopping)
places.ai_summary: A modern shopping mall in Kandy, offering a variety of shops, restaurants, and a cinema.
places.cost: Free entry, shopping at own expense

opening_hours.notes: Check for individual store hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the food court for a variety of dining options.

attribution.title: SL Kandy asv2020-01 img05 Queens Hotel
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Queen's Hotel in Kandy, Sri Lanka

places.name: Kandy Garrison Cemetery
places.ai_summary: A historic cemetery in Kandy, the final resting place of many British colonial officials and soldiers.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available on request.

places.place_tip: Respect the solemnity of the place; guided tours provide great historical insights.

places.name: Commonwealth War Cemetery
places.ai_summary: A well-maintained cemetery commemorating the soldiers of the Commonwealth who died in World War II.

opening_hours.notes: Open to visitors at all times.

places.place_tip: Take a moment to reflect; the cemetery is a peaceful and respectful place.

places.name: Ceylon Tea Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history and production of Ceylon tea, located in a former tea factory.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the tea tasting session.

attribution.title: KANDY TEA MUSEUM KANDY TOWN SRI LANKA JAN 2013 (8583226551)
attribution.author: calflier001
attribution.description: KANDY TEA MUSEUM KANDY TOWN SRI LANKA JAN 2013

places.name: Asgiriya Temple Complex
places.ai_summary: A complex of historic temples and shrines, significant in the Buddhist and Hindu traditions.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering.

places.place_tip: Explore the intricate carvings and peaceful surroundings.

attribution.title: Dharmaraja-Kingswood
attribution.author: Astronomyinertia
attribution.description: A photo taken at the Dharmaraja-Kingswood 104th encounter at Asgiriya stadium on 6th March 2010

places.name: Natha Devalaya
places.ai_summary: An important Hindu temple in Kandy, dedicated to the god Vishnu.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the pooja (prayer) ceremonies if interested.

places.place_tip: The temple is especially vibrant during the festivals.

attribution.title: Kataragama Maha Devale
attribution.author: Ghostface Buddha
attribution.description: The central Kataragama shrine, with Ganesh shrine in the background

places.name: Kandy Market Hall
places.ai_summary: A bustling market in Kandy, offering a variety of local produce, spices, and handicrafts.
places.cost: Free entry, shopping at own expense

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Try the local fruits and spices; great place for souvenirs.

places.name: Cultural Dance Performance Hall
places.ai_summary: A venue showcasing traditional Sri Lankan dance performances, a great way to experience the local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for specific performance times.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance during peak tourist season.

places.name: Sri Maha Bodhi Viharaya
places.ai_summary: A Buddhist temple in Kandy, known for its sacred fig tree, believed to be a sapling from the original Bodhi tree in India.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the morning puja for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: The temple is a peaceful place for meditation and reflection.

attribution.title: Sri Maha Bodhi Vihara Statue
attribution.author: Price Zero
attribution.description: Buddha statue of Sri Maha Bodhi Viharaya

places.name: Hanthana Mountain Hike
places.ai_summary: A hiking trail in the Hanthana Mountain Range, offering stunning views of Kandy and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Best to start early morning to avoid heat and enjoy the sunrise.

places.place_tip: Carry water and snacks; wear comfortable hiking shoes.

attribution.title: Hanthana range
attribution.author: Astronomyinertia
attribution.description: A view of the Hanthana range

places.name: Kandy Railway Station Architecture
places.ai_summary: An iconic railway station in Kandy, known for its unique architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Photography is allowed; be respectful to the commuters.

places.place_tip: The station is especially beautiful in the early morning light.

attribution.title: SL Kandy asv2020-01 img03 Railway station
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Railway station in Kandy, Sri Lanka

places.name: Wales Park View
places.ai_summary: A public park in Kandy, offering a peaceful environment and a great view of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: A great spot for a picnic or just to relax and enjoy the view.

places.name: Embekke Wood Carving Temple
places.ai_summary: A famous temple known for its intricate wood carvings and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available.

places.place_tip: Admire the detailed carvings and learn about the temple's history.

places.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage (En Route)
places.ai_summary: A renowned elephant orphanage and rehabilitation center, a bit outside Kandy, but worth the visit.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit during feeding times for an interactive experience.

places.place_tip: Do not feed the elephants without permission; photography is allowed.

attribution.title: Pinnawala 01
attribution.author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution.description: Elephant orphanage at Pinnawala, Sri Lanka
